author: Shoto_
body:
So yesterday on Frostbite I realized it would be cool if there was an igloo map, I shared my idea, and some other people agreed. After that map rotation, I started building on a void world, and ended up with this.

Obviously, it's not finished yet, as it is too small.
But just tell me some ideas, and I can make the map a whole lot better when it is released. :)
I am already going to have a few more islands with igloos on them, but I would really appreciate any ideas/feedback. Thanks. :)
